维护者指示（2026-11-21T16:44Z）：协调席问「菜单图标的卡 #36141 也一起通知派发吗？」，维护者：「一起派发」。

- 交给席位 `repo:objectstack#1`（os-sales）派发本卡。信箱里按这条记录敲门。
- 本卡和「去掉顶栏」专题的 objectstack-ai/objectstack#36112 都动侧栏的菜单项，谁先谁后请席位自己排，在卡上说一声。
- 本卡第 4 项（没设颜色的对象自动分配一个颜色）是协调席加的做法，维护者没有单独表态；已写在正文「协调席自己加的」里。

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim: PM loop · 2026-11-21T16:55Z · area b1-CX (epic #34571; taken from the mailbox, record 7065885381, the maintainer's 「一起派发」).
Area: b1-CX
Session: `session_01L6bhgWopgUHAVkDYdjqW8g` (card thread)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-j1p8m3
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: `@object-ui/components` `custom/object-icon-tile.tsx` (a neutral tile variant, exported), `@object-ui/layout` `NavigationRenderer` (leaf and action arms), app-shell `nav-menu-renderer.tsx`, `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` (Recent, Favorites, Starred), `HomeRail.tsx` (Recently accessed); tests in the existing harness files; changeset.
Container & model: `L`, card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening): a new exported neutral tile on `@object-ui/components`, possibly a kind-glyph helper on `@object-ui/layout`; re-measured on built declarations before push.
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (thread, read on main `f5553525`, file `build-seat1/36141/premise-read.md` in the project folder): holds for items 1–3 and 5–7. Authored `icon` always wins; non-object kinds get one neutral tile (light grey square, dark grey glyph, same size and radius as the object tile), no per-kind colour; the emoji in Recent, Favorites and Starred go; the phone home menu (item 7) rides the same renderer and is checked by a 375 screenshot.
Basis: card #36141; epic #34571.
Scope, the seat's reading: items 1–3 and 5–7 now. Item 4 (an object with no colour gets an automatic colour) is held out of this branch: it was added by the coordinator, it reverses #35985's merged neutral fallback, and it would move the PR onto the spec text (`Metadata-protocol: semantic`, Fable L2). It went through a Fable review and is with the maintainer on a decision card; the recommendation is to keep the grey fallback and let packages set colours. If he rules for automatic colour it comes in as its own commit here and this claim is amended.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: this card goes before #36112 (the top bar removal re-orders the sidebar and will merge main over this card; both touch `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`). Overlap: #36131 does not overlap items 1–3, 5–7 (item 4 would touch `objectViewPageHeader.tsx`); #36089 no file overlap. `overlap-check.mjs` before each push. Declaration L2 at `TIER_DEFAULT` on the green head; L1 at L1-b. The PR carries `Fixes #36141` only if item 4 is ruled out or built; while item 4 is open the PR says `Part of #36141`.
